reels.title: 4 GitHub repos for advanced design effects with Claude Code
reels.summary: Cindy Zhu's tutorial 'How to create Advanced Design Effects using Claude & GitHub' argues that vibe coding with Claude Code has closed the historical gap between designers creating visuals and engineers making them functional. She shares four GitHub repos to 'steal' for projects: React Three Fiber (drops the full Three.js library into a site), Liquid Glass JS (Apple-like liquid glass effect with full controls), Shader Gradient (moving gradients customizable by shape, color, and motion in React), and Liquid Logo (a chrome liquid-metal look applicable to anything). Her workflow: don't download or hand-code these yourself — point Claude Code at the repo and describe the effect you want. From the caption she adds a caution: treat a repo as reference code, not a magic asset — check the licence, maintenance, and framework first, then ask Claude Code to isolate the smallest effect you need and adapt it inside a disposable branch before merging.

reels.title: Skill of the week: Annotated Illustrations for Claude Code
reels.summary: Remy (@aiwithremy) presents his 'Skill of the week': 'Annotated Illustrations' by designer Ian, a skill for Claude Code. His premise: vibe coding makes it easy to build working apps, but the problem is you end up not understanding how they work. Run this skill after a big build and the agent explores the codebase, maps the moving parts — components like input, auth, queue, agent, store, and notify — then generates a simple hand-drawn flowchart showing what happens and in what order. He positions it as the fix for losing track of things in complex systems and useful for briefing new teammates or non-technical collaborators, and shows the illustration it produced for an onboarding flow he built. Ends with a CTA to comment 'SKILL' to receive the tool.

reels.title: Geometric-Art.com: free tool turning footage into animated line art
reels.summary: Ramshad (@aartstock) demos Geometric-Art.com, a free website for graphic and motion designers that turns uploaded images or video into abstract animated line art. The workflow: upload a photo or clip, pick effects from the side panel, and customize — the demo shows PRO settings like PORTRAIT WINDOW and SPECTRAL CURTAIN on an athletic-wear portrait, and effects reacting automatically to motion in a sunglasses video clip. You adjust size, thickness, and colors, then export the result as a high-quality image, video, or embed.
